3. Maintain firmware versions, release notes, and change logs.
4. Track hardware revisions and ensure firmware compatibility.

442d2607ee4b0f32.description:
We are looking for a self-driven Full Stack Web Development Intern who wants hands-on experience building and deploying real-world web applications.

The intern will work on small-scale products, micro-projects, internal tools, and innovative ideas, taking ownership of tasks from development through deployment. Depending on project requirements, you will work with technologies such as React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PHP, and MySQL.

This is not a classroom-style training internship. We provide mentorship, technical direction, and resources, but the intern is expected to research, implement, debug, and deliver solutions independently.



A. Development

1. Work on assigned development tasks, features, and project modules.
2. Build frontend interfaces using React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, or Tailwind CSS.
3. Develop backend APIs and business logic using Node.js/Express.js or PHP.
4. Work with MongoDB and MySQL for database design and integration.
5. Integrate frontend, backend, APIs, and databases into functional applications.
6. Convert requirements and ideas into working features.

B. Debugging & Problem-Solving

1. Identify and resolve bugs in existing applications.
2. Debug frontend, backend, API, database, and deployment-related issues.
3. Research and troubleshoot technical problems independently before seeking assistance.
4. Optimize applications for performance, reliability, and scalability.
5. Test features thoroughly before submitting them for review.
6. Demonstrate strong debugging skills and the ability to resolve issues efficiently.

C. Git & GitHub

1. Use Git and GitHub as part of daily development workflows.
2. Commit completed work regularly with clean, descriptive commit messages.
3. Maintain proper branches where required.
4. Push code to assigned repositories and keep repositories organized.
5. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
6. Maintain regular GitHub activity as part of the internship's reporting and evaluation process.

D. Deployment

1. Deploy frontend applications and backend services/APIs.
2. Configure databases, environment variables, and application settings.
3. Manage staging and production environments.
4. Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related issues.
5. Work with platforms such as AWS, Vercel, Netlify, or Heroku, depending on project requirements.

E. Documentation

1. Maintain technical documentation for assigned projects and modules.
2. Document project overviews, setup instructions, and technologies used.
3. Document database structures and APIs.
4. Maintain environment configuration and deployment instructions.
5. Document known issues and important implementation decisions.
6. Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation as part of the formal performance evaluation.

F. Daily Communication

1. Attend assigned meetings and technical discussions.
2. Clearly communicate completed work and ongoing progress.
3. Report blockers promptly instead of waiting until deadlines.
4. Explain technical decisions and implementation approaches clearly.
5. Ask specific questions when assistance is required.
6. Provide realistic estimates for assigned tasks and deliverables.
442d2607ee4b0f32.title: Full Stack Development

About the Internship

We’re looking for an AI Engineer Intern who can build AI-powered product features using modern AI application development frameworks.

This is not a machine learning research role. You won’t be expected to train models from scratch or have advanced knowledge of ML mathematics. We’re looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of building AI applications using Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, and RAG, and wants to apply these skills to real SaaS products.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team to build and integrate AI capabilities into existing and upcoming products.

What You’ll Do

1. Build backend services and AI APIs using Python and FastAPI.
2. Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into SaaS products.
3. Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
4. Work with Vector Databases for embeddings, semantic search, and contextual retrieval.
5. Build LLM-powered applications using LangChain.
6. Design stateful, multi-step workflows and AI agents using LangGraph.
7. Build tool-using AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, and product services.
8. Integrate LLM APIs with internal backend systems.
9. Work with structured and unstructured data, including JSON, documents, APIs, and databases.
10. Implement document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and generation pipelines.
11. Experiment with prompts, models, retrieval strategies, tools, and agent architectures.
12. Test AI responses for accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
13. Build prototypes and convert successful experiments into product features.
14. Write clean, maintainable, and understandable code.
15. Document and demonstrate the AI features you build.

Required Skills

1. Hands-on knowledge of Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, RAG, REST APIs, and JSON.
2. Comfortable building backend APIs using Python and FastAPI.
3. Experience creating LLM applications using LangChain.
4. Ability to build workflows and agents using LangGraph.
5. Understanding of and hands-on experience with RAG pipelines.
6. Ability to create embeddings and work with Vector Databases.
7. Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP requests, and JSON.
8. Ability to debug applications and understand technical documentation.
9. Ability to independently implement solutions through experimentation.

Professional experience is not required. Projects, hackathons, college work, GitHub repositories, prototypes, and personal learning projects are all valid.

What We’re Looking For

1. Strong programming fundamentals.
2. Good problem-solving and debugging skills.
3. Ability to convert requirements into working features.
4. Curiosity about AI applications and AI agents.
5. Willingness to experiment, iterate, and learn from failures.
6. Ability to learn quickly through documentation and hands-on work.
7. A builder mindset — we value working projects over theoretical knowledge.

Seeking a "nerd" Quantitative Trading Intern with Python programming skills and craze for technical analysis. You will translate trading strategies from TradingView PineScript into modular Python code, execute rigorous historical backtests, and deploy strategies into live/paper trading environments via OpenAlgo and broker APIs.

Key Responsibilities
Script Conversion: Translate PineScript strategies and custom indicators (such as Pivot SuperTrend, ATR stops, and dynamic pivot levels) into clean, vectorized Python code using pandas, numpy, or numba.

Backtesting & Optimization: Build and execute backtests on multi-year historical data. Calculate core strategy metrics including Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate, profit factor, and trade frequency.

Live Market Testing: Set up forward/paper trading environments to evaluate real-time strategy performance, latency, and signal reliability under actual market conditions.

Execution & API Integration: Connect Python strategy engines to OpenAlgo and broker APIs (e.g., Zerodha Kite, Angel One, Fyers) using Webhooks or REST endpoints.

Risk Management: Account for real-world execution friction such as slippage, transaction costs, order placement logic, and trailing stop adjustments.

Job Title: Recruitment Intern
Company: Aureva Capital Private Limited 
Location: Ghatkopar West, Mumbai (In-office) 
Internship Duration: 3 Months (Full-Time) 

About Aureva Capital
Aureva Capital is a Mumbai-based Wealth Management and Financial Advisory firm. We are focused on empowering individuals and families to achieve their financial goals through personalized advisory, technology-driven insights, and innovative investment solutions. As we build out our next-generation digital investment platform, we are rapidly scaling our core teams. 

Role Overview
We are seeking an energetic and proactive Recruitment Intern to drive end-to-end talent acquisition across multiple functional areas, including Technology, Sales, Content Writing, and Operations. Working closely with leadership, you will play a key role in identifying, engaging, and onboarding top talent to accelerate our company’s growth.

Key Responsibilities
1. Sourcing & Pipeline Building: Actively source prospective candidates across job portals, LinkedIn, college networks, and niche talent communities for open roles in Tech, Sales, Operations, and Content.
2. Screening & Assessment: Review resumes, conduct initial screening calls to assess fit and communication, and shortlist candidates against role specifications.
3. Interview Coordination: Schedule and manage interview rounds between candidates and hiring managers/founders, ensuring a smooth, timely evaluation process.
4. Candidate Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring lifecycle, maintaining transparent communication and follow-ups.
5. Job Postings & Campus Outreach: Draft and post engaging job descriptions across multiple platforms and assist with campus recruitment initiatives.
6. Recruitment Operations: Maintain internal applicant tracking data, coordinate offer rollout logistics, and support basic onboarding activities.

What We Are Looking For
• Education: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields preferred).
• Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to effectively engage and evaluate candidates.
• Multi-Domain Hiring Interest: Curiosity and quick adaptability to understand job requirements across technical (Full Stack, Data) and non-technical (Sales, Editorial, Ops) domains.
• Ownership & Drive: High energy, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Tools & Platforms: Familiarity with LinkedIn sourcing, job boards (Internshala, Naukri, Wellfound, etc.), and Google Workspace/MS Excel.

What You Will Gain
1. Hands-on, end-to-end recruitment experience across diverse business functions within a high-growth fintech environment. 
2. Direct exposure to business founders and decision-makers. 
3. Practical knowledge of tech stacks, sales metrics, and operational hiring dynamics.
4. Certificate of Internship and Letter of Recommendation (based on performance).

About the Role:

1. Analyze sales, product, inventory, and financial data across the complete datasets of our clients.

f70321179eb919c9.description:
About Suvitt:

Suvitt is a virtual CFO, governance, and compliance advisory firm working with growing companies and family businesses. We function like a fractional CFO office, covering MIS and dashboards, payroll, statutory compliance, transaction structuring, and founder-office support. We are building internal systems (Freshdesk-based operations, structured reporting, knowledge capture) that let our team run reliably without one person having to remember and chase everything.

The Role:

We are hiring an intern to own the plumbing between our operational tools—Freshdesk, Outlook/Microsoft 365, and our knowledge-capture systems (Notion/OneNote)—and to bring disciplined AI usage into our daily reporting and workflows. This is not a “build me an AI chatbot” role. It is a systems and process role in which AI is one tool among several, used carefully and only where it adds real value.

You will start with real, contained problems (cleaning up Freshdesk reporting, designing an email-to-notes capture pipeline) and grow into owning the automation layer across our practice.



1. Migrate our daily and weekly Freshdesk reports (SLA breach dashboards, statutory deadline tracking, exception alerts) from ad-hoc AI-run tasks to reliable, scheduled, auditable pipelines.
2. Design and build an email-to-notes capture system so that important team emails flow into a shared knowledge base (Notion or OneNote) without duplicating what Freshdesk already tracks.
3. Work with APIs, webhooks, and no-code/low-code tools (Power Automate, Make, n8n, or Zapier) to connect our systems.
4. Write documentation and runbooks that a non-technical team lead can follow.
5. Use AI (Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Copilot) thoughtfully—for summarisation and classification, never for numbers, dates, or decisions that carry client risk.
6. Track and reduce the cost and credit footprint of our AI-assisted workflows.

Suvitt Service Solutions LLP is an equal opportunity employer. We assess every application on merit alone.
f70321179eb919c9.title: AI Automation
